name: cx.d1.pushsdk.infra.D1PushSdkEventActionBroadcastReceiver
description: When the user taps a DirectOne Smarkio Push notification or one of its buttons, this Receiver clears the notification and opens the app or linked page. It also records the notification interaction.
disableEffect: DirectOne notification taps and buttons will no longer open their destination, and their interactions will not be recorded.
